verdict.rationale: Rootly's Alert Routes docs say incoming alerts from monitoring tools are routed to teams, services, and escalation policies "based on conditions you define" through a unified routing layer across all alert sources. Deduplication of repeat monitor events and API-based creation from monitoring tools support the ingestion side. Missing for 10: a documented list of specific monitoring-tool alert sources/integrations, detail on routing condition types, and independent or hands-on corroboration of routing.
